Which counties contain the most water area?
SELECT name, usps AS state, max(try_cast(awater_sqmi AS double)) AS water_sq_mi FROM govblock_census.gazetteer_gaz_counties GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How many 13F holdings reports were filed for the quarter ending December 2024?
SELECT count(*) AS reports FROM govblock_sec.sec_13f_submission WHERE submissiontype = '13F-HR' AND periodofreport = '31-DEC-2024'
Which subsidized housing projects in California are the largest?
SELECT name, program_label, try_cast(total_units AS double) AS units FROM govblock_housing.hud_psh_project WHERE states = 'CA California' ORDER BY 3 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many providers are eligible to order and refer under Medicare Part B?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.cms_order_and_referring WHERE partb = 'Y'
From which states does the most money reach section 527 political groups?
SELECT column09 AS state, round(sum(try_cast(column13 AS double))) AS contributions FROM govblock_nonprofits.pol_org_8872_contributions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How has New York State's yearly average unemployment rate moved over the past decade?
SELECT year, value AS rate FROM govblock_labor.bls_la_data WHERE series_id = 'LAUST360000000000003' AND period = 'M13' ORDER BY year DESC LIMIT 10
Which states' clinicians received the most Medicare payments in the latest year?
Medicare Physician Other Practitioners By Provider

SELECT rndrng_prvdr_state_abrvtn AS state, round(sum(try_cast(tot_mdcr_pymt_amt AS double))) AS medicare_paid FROM govblock_health.medicare_physician_other_practitioners_by_provider WHERE source_file = (SELECT max(source_file) FROM govblock_health.medicare_physician_other_practitioners_by_provider) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many applications build on a provisional application filed earlier?
SELECT count(DISTINCT application_number) AS applications FROM govblock_patents.patex_continuity_parents_25 WHERE continuation_type = 'PRO'
What were the most common reasons for hospital stays in New York in 2016?
SELECT ccs_diagnosis_description, count(*) AS discharges FROM govblock_health.ny_sparcs_inpatient_discharges WHERE cast(discharge_year AS varchar) = '2016' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many molecules in ChEMBL carry a black box warning?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_molecule_dictionary WHERE black_box_warning = 1
How far apart are studio and four-bedroom fair market rents in Los Angeles County?
SELECT areaname, try_cast(fmr0 AS double) AS studio, try_cast(fmr4 AS double) AS four_bedroom FROM govblock_housing.hud_fmr_fmrs_sheet_excel_data WHERE countyname = 'Los Angeles County' LIMIT 5
Which specialties have the most clinicians billing Medicare?
Medicare Physician Other Practitioners By Provider

SELECT rndrng_prvdr_type AS specialty, count(DISTINCT rndrng_npi) AS clinicians FROM govblock_health.medicare_physician_other_practitioners_by_provider WHERE source_file = (SELECT max(source_file) FROM govblock_health.medicare_physician_other_practitioners_by_provider) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did carbon dioxide from U.S. power plants change from 2010 to 2023?
SELECT year(date) AS year, sum(co2_mass_short_tons) AS co2_short_tons FROM govblock_environment.campd_emissions_hourly WHERE year(date) IN (2010, 2023) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which countries bought the most American exports in 2019?

SELECT cty_name, max(try_cast(all_val_yr AS double)) AS exports FROM govblock_trade.census_exp_cty WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2019' AND try_cast(cty_code AS integer) >= 1000 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many New Yorkers were hospitalised for pneumonia in 2016?
SELECT count(*) AS stays FROM govblock_health.ny_sparcs_inpatient_discharges WHERE discharge_year = '2016' AND ccs_diagnosis_description LIKE 'Pneumonia%'
Which counties paid the highest average weekly wage in the first quarter of 2024?
Jobs and Wages by County and Industry

SELECT t.area_title, try_cast(q.avg_wkly_wage AS double) AS weekly_wage FROM govblock_labor.qcew_quarterly AS q JOIN govblock_labor.qcew_area_titles AS t ON t.area_fips = q.area_fips WHERE q.agglvl_code = '70' AND q.own_code = '0' AND q.year = '2024' AND q.qtr = '1' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
What does Medicare Part D spend per Eliquis prescription on average?
Medicare Part D Prescribers By Geography And Drug

SELECT round(try_cast(tot_drug_cst AS double) / try_cast(tot_clms AS double), 2) AS cost_per_claim FROM govblock_health.medicare_part_d_prescribers_by_geography_and_drug WHERE prscrbr_geo_lvl = 'National' AND brnd_name = 'Eliquis' AND source_file = (SELECT max(source_file) FROM govblock_health.medicare_part_d_prescribers_by_geography_and_drug)
Why do Connecticut consumers complain about insurers most often?
SELECT reason, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_insurance_filings.ct_insurance_complaints WHERE reason IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many Materials Project entries are theoretical, with no known lab synthesis?
SELECT count(*) AS materials FROM govblock_materials.mp_summary WHERE cast(theoretical AS varchar) = 'true'
In which counties do the most adults report depression?

SELECT concat(locationname, ', ', stateabbr) AS county, try_cast(data_value AS double) AS percent FROM govblock_health.cdc_places_county WHERE measureid = 'DEPRESSION' AND datavaluetypeid = 'AgeAdjPrv' AND year = '2022' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
Did New York or New England use more electricity at 6 p.m. on July 20, 2023?
SELECT series_id, value FROM govblock_energy.eia_eba_data WHERE series_id IN ('EBA.NYIS-ALL.D.H', 'EBA.ISNE-ALL.D.H') AND period = '20230720T22'
How many people worked in food manufacturing in 2023?
Jobs and Wages by County and Industry
SELECT try_cast(annual_avg_emplvl AS double) AS jobs FROM govblock_labor.qcew_annual WHERE area_fips = 'US000' AND agglvl_code = '15' AND own_code = '5' AND industry_code = '311' AND year = '2023'
Which coal mines shipped the most fuel to power plants?
Eia923 Eia Schedules M Final Revision Page Fuel Receipts And Costs

SELECT coalmine_name, coalmine_state, sum(try_cast(quantity AS double)) AS tons FROM govblock_energy.eia923_eia_schedules_m_final_revision_sheet_page_fuel_receipts_and_costs WHERE fuel_group = 'Coal' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How many unanimous Supreme Court decisions are recorded for the 1990s?
SELECT count(*) AS decisions FROM govblock_courts.opinion_clusters WHERE scdb_id <> '' AND date_filed BETWEEN '1990' AND '2000' AND cast(scdb_votes_minority AS varchar) = '0'
At which colleges do graduates leave with the highest median debt?
SELECT instnm, try_cast(grad_debt_mdn AS double) AS median_debt FROM govblock_education.scorecard_most_recent_institution ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How much have violators committed to supplemental environmental projects?
SELECT sum(try_cast(total_sep AS double)) AS total FROM govblock_environment.echo_case_penalties
Which medical schools trained the most clinicians enrolled in Medicare?
SELECT med_sch, count(DISTINCT npi) AS clinicians FROM govblock_health.cc_dac_nationaldownloadablefile GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much federal assistance went to recipients in New York in fiscal year 2021?

SELECT sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_assistance WHERE recipient_state_code = 'NY' AND cast(action_date_fiscal_year AS varchar) = '2021'
Which New York zones had the highest average real-time power price in 2023?
Nyiso Lmp Real Time Hourly Rtlbmp Zone

SELECT name, avg(try_cast(lbmp_mwhr AS double)) AS dollars_per_mwh FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_lmp_real_time_hourly_rtlbmp_zone WHERE substr(time_stamp, 7, 4) = '2023' AND name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much in penalties has EPA recorded as collected?
SELECT sum(try_cast(penalty_collected_amt AS double)) AS total FROM govblock_environment.echo_case_penalties
What did a hospital stay for chronic lung disease cost on average in New York in 2016?

SELECT round(avg(try_cast(total_costs AS double)), 0) AS avg_cost FROM govblock_health.ny_sparcs_inpatient_discharges WHERE discharge_year = '2016' AND ccs_diagnosis_description LIKE 'Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease%'
How did U.S. per capita personal income change from 2000 to 2024?
SELECT try_cast(_2000 AS double) AS in_2000, try_cast(_2024 AS double) AS in_2024 FROM govblock_economy.bea_cainc1 WHERE geofips = '00000' AND linecode = '3'
How many hospitals reported a net loss for fiscal 2023?

SELECT count(DISTINCT rpt_rec_num) AS hospitals FROM govblock_health.hcris_hosp10_nmrc WHERE wksht_cd = 'G300000' AND line_num = '02900' AND clmn_num = '00100' AND cast(hcris_fy AS varchar) = '2023' AND try_cast(itm_val_num AS double) < 0
Which states have the most registered hazardous waste handlers?
SELECT state_code, count(*) AS facilities FROM govblock_environment.echo_rcra_facilities GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
